verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents a first-party MCP server that connects it to any AI tool, with a dedicated mcp-server doc page covering authentication by sign-in or API key. A probe also confirms an official MCP server repository. missing for 10: documentation of the exposed MCP tool surface and setup steps, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP Server: Connect Firecrawl to any AI tool via the Model Context Protocol
Choose how the connection will authenticate. Signing in and adding an API key are two paths to the same access
